import hashlib, json, pathlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
base = pathlib.Path('products/services/catalogue-agency-buyer-trial')
raw = (base / 'raw/discovery.rss').read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '3e2b8fcb4d72cd9c7ddb415dc1f0961a73ed7f9d5cd9bae5205c63603522dcf5', 'Saved feed does not match FETCH receipt'
root = ET.fromstring(raw)
rows = []
for item in root.findall('./channel/item'):
    url = (item.findtext('link') or '').strip()
    link = urlsplit(url)
    if link.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or not link.hostname or link.username or link.password:
        continue
    rows.append({'title': (item.findtext('title') or '')[:240], 'url': url, 'host': link.hostname, 'snippet': (item.findtext('description') or '')[:480]})
result = {'source_receipt': 'TASK-179510941201', 'source_sha256': digest, 'result_count': len(rows), 'evidence_scope': 'Unverified search leads. No buyer request, active deadline, paid terms or response permission established.', 'results': rows}
output = base / 'discovery-leads.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'result_count': len(rows)}))
